column5: D112 corpus code: the pinned seed predates D111, so a str read from a borrowed Corpus record or a &str passed where build-layer APIs take str is cloned (each removal was refused by the seed); the post-D111-seed build/ sweep removes them

#2390: the empty wo-wasm32 slots thread Build/Target through the existing consuming helpers (add_empty_wo_blob_targets/target_with_empty_wo_blobs) at three cross embedded sites; each move spells the builder-pattern ownership transfer those signatures declare, as every neighboring call does
D124 (#2329): the new wrapping-constant-cast diagnostic is emitted through the same Diagnostic ownership transfer as the neighboring negated-membership lint
#1856 (§4.2.1): the three pending-soft-use lists join the FnBodyEnv scope snapshot beside the pending-generic maps; each move spells the same env ownership transfer every neighboring field declares

the pattern joins the census with this change: the 124 dbg_puts/make_str sites of rt_core.w are swept here (dbg_puts takes &str); what remains is the byte-level seams (rt_write, rt_buf_write_ascii, dbg_cstr_eq_lit, the platform files), the next sweep, and the bar records them at the reseed

D151: BTreeMap/BTreeSet are facades over the M*LIB B+tree; their Clone impls, set algebra and the engine's key-slot cloner copy each element through a view with `.clone()` (the engine owns no second copy, §2.3), as the HashSet ones do; nine are D63's fn-value clones (`fn(A) -> R` is not Copy: the slot prefix's comparator, cloner and dropper read through a pointer or a view)

#2449: InternPool and AstPool are counted handles over one shared, append-only state; a type that keeps a handle stores `pool.clone()`, the explicit second-holder spelling (Rc.clone), because With offers no implicit alias and the compiler phases each hold the pool today; the single-owner restructure (one pool per compilation, every phase borrowing it) removes them, and the bar records them at the reseed

D30 step 3: the standard library imports the runtime interface, so the runtime modules join the unit `with check src/main.w --ceremony-census` reports and their sites land under rt/, an area the bar predates; the count is the runtime's existing `let _ = 0` empty bodies, not new ceremony, and the bar records it at the next reseed

D30 step 3: as above — the runtime's existing literal pointer-length writes (rt_write of a message), reported under rt/ once the runtime joins the checked unit; the bar records them at the next reseed

D144 (#2541): seed-blocked sites — the pinned seed, without D144, refuses the unannotated `let i = self.idx` before `self.idx += 1`; swept once a seed with D144 is pinned, as D103's seed-blocked sites were (415: two more in CImport.w's hoisted initializer-element setups, the STC branch); one more under the same seed (SemaCheck's saved_raw_derefs, §21.1 rule 6's clause work), swept with the rest

D148/D149: the STC facades (priority_queue, ordered_set, ordered_map, deque, unordered_set, unordered_map) transfer a value out of engine-indexed storage by vacating the value field of a facade-owned slot through its raw pointer — pop, remove, a replaced entry, drop — the one D27 spelling of that transfer, as the c-algorithms facades (engine_slot) spell it; the bar records them at the reseed; D151: BTreeMap/BTreeSet own their entry records through the M*LIB engine and vacate a replaced, removed, popped or drained entry's key and value with D32's explicit `move` (12 sites in collections.w)

D148's word shape for the B+tree: the re-promoted mlib corpus (lib/std/engines/mlib/facade_shapes.w gains the word tree's migrated functions, with the migrator's move spelling) and BTreeMap/BTreeSet's ten word-path transfers of a key and a value out of a facade-owned entry through a raw pointer (`unsafe { move entry.key }`), the spelling the slot paths beside them use

D172 (§3.2): a `mut` method on `self` takes `self.ast.clone()` (an AstPool holder count) rather than the field place `self.ast`, which ct_eval_truthy never writes; per-field footprints (D172, planned) remove it

A global initializer that creates a closure is lowered with the module (lower_module): its body and closures leave the ephemeral MirBuilder by D32 field vacates, the spelling lower_module's other bodies use; neither a `move fn` on MirBuilder nor a by-value MirBuilder parameter may vacate (an ephemeral parameter reads as a view)

D172 step 6, seed-bound: Memo.get copies its value out with `Some(v) => Some(*v)` because the pinned seed, which compiles src/ and so std.memo, does not copy an `Option[&V]` out at an owned `Option[V]` tail (D22); the tail becomes `(unsafe *map).get(key)` at the next seed

D172 PR B: substitute_current takes the current substitution lists as values (O(1), D120): building a type can specialize, and a specialization replaces the lists while it runs, so a view of the field would outlive what it views; before the read-only receivers the callers passed `&self.generic_subst_param_syms` through a mut Sema parameter, which no rule checked
D178: footprint_mark, the one place a footprint path offset is read from footprint_path_data's length (an i32 offset as the entries store it), as borrow_path_mark is for the borrow paths
